raw_http_text: {"id":"f1c6db48-2870-4888-a631-f9f32081f5ae_2srdz2g3z7i3bb16v4_72a15e90575d4ea7a4de1e0d5274c1e2","choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"{\"schema_version\":\"1.0\",\"packet_id\":\"CAND_TOPIC_01_R2_V1\",\"mode\":\"organized_reflection\",\"sentences\":[{\"text\":\"人类活动使大气二氧化碳增加，溶入海洋的二氧化碳也随之增加，但证据未给出某年吸收比例、速度或上限。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E04\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"海洋酸化指氢离子浓度上升、pH下降的方向，海水平均仍呈碱性却可继续酸化，两者并不矛盾。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E05\"],\"kind\":\"limitation\"},{\"text\":\"2016年植被变绿研究区分观测与归因，叶面积增加的检出依赖数据，各驱动因素作用需借助模型判断。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"在未给出某年吸收比例、速度或上限的条件下，能否仅凭大气与海洋吸收的联系，推断海洋可持续完全抵消排放？\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"question\"}]}","role":"assistant","tool_calls":null}}],"created":1794399552,"model":"mimo-v2.6-flash","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"completion_tokens":223,"prompt_tokens":1695,"total_tokens":1918,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens_details":null}}
